_district_scope_note: Shire DISTRICT (lower tier of two-tier Staffordshire). NO adult social care, NO children's, NO DSG, NO HRA. The upper tier (ASC, children's, education, highways) is Staffordshire County Council (also Reform-run).
_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing Conservative administration (11 Feb 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 (flipped from Conservative) and formed the Cabinet 21 May 2026, inheriting the budget; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.

administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election (27 of 44; Conservative 15, Labour 2), flipping from Conservative control. Leader Cllr Jonathan Gullis (the former Conservative MP for Stoke-on-Trent North; also holds Planning and Town Centres). A shire district; the county tier is Staffordshire CC (Reform-run).

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114/EFS/BVN; a routine Section 25 robustness statement). A live Local Government Reorganisation review (Staffordshire two-tier) is a GBP 485k pressure and an existential question.
